This small plot is only 0.11 hectare, and I grow something other than the main cereals here — maybe some vegetables or root crops for the house. I have no schooling and money is tight, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for such a small piece. I will put manure from my animals, use my own saved seed like my father did, and work it with my family's hands. Water comes from the rain as God sends it.
